title: Texas Small Claims Court (2026): Limit, Fees & How to File
rank_math_title: Texas Small Claims Court (2026): $20,000 Limit & Costs
rank_math_description: Texas small claims in 2026: $20,000 justice court limit, $54 filing + service, 14-day answer, $22 jury, 21-day appeal and why wages can't be garnished.
pdf_outline: Checklist: demand letter -> venue (county + precinct, Rule 502.4) -> Small Claims Petition -> file & pay ($54 + service) -> service (Rule 501.2) -> 14-day answer / default -> jury demand 14 days before trial ($22) -> trial -> 21-day appeal window -> collection
Collection reality box: wages exempt; bank garnishment, execution, abstract of judgment
